property_summary: In the correct contract, withdrawAll only succeeds when called by the deployer (owner) and fails for any other caller; the mutant inverts the check so some non-owner callers can succeed (and the owner may fail), producing a differing success boolean for some fuzzed caller addresses.
change_summary: Change the access check to require msg.sender != owner instead of ==, inverting the guard so withdrawAll can be called by non-owners and thus observable behavior (who can withdraw) changes.
